claimText: Für Elise, beginner arrangement: bars 0-4 quote the opening of WoO 59 (values doubled, 3/8 as 3/4) with named changes; bars 5-16 are our own

differenceNotes: bar 1: the C5 before bar 2's A is left out, and the third E is a quarter note to keep the bar full - declared departure (keeps the run of equal notes within the Beginner limit)
bar 3: G4 instead of G#4 - declared departure (no accidentals after bar 1)
bar 4: D5 instead of D#5 - declared departure (no accidentals after bar 1)

outcomeNote: Checked 2026-09-24 against Mutopia 931. The pickup and bars 1-4 quote Beethoven's melody with values doubled; the melody check found three changes the old description hid or misstated (the C5 left out in bar 1, G for G# in bar 3, D for D# in bar 4). Keeping them keeps the item at Beginner (restoring the C makes a run of 8 equal notes, over the cap of 4, and Beginner is at its minimum of 7 items), so they are named as departures (research R10 rule 6). Bars 5-16 are our own and are not compared. No note changed.
